This is the course's **knowledge base**: standalone pages you can come back to during any week (or after the course). Weekly lessons link into this section; the material here is meant to outlive any single class.

## AI & LLM fundamentals

- [LLM Glossary](../da-knowledge/technical-terms-page.qmd) — technical terms used in lectures and class.
- [Which AI to use](../da-knowledge/which-ai.qmd) — November 2026 comparison of major models and tools.
- [Open-weights & local models](../da-knowledge/open-weights-models.qmd) — models you can download and run yourself.
- [Running AI on your own computer](../da-knowledge/run-ai-locally.qmd) — a good model on a top laptop, a simple model on an ordinary one.
- [Open-code tools & harnesses](../da-knowledge/open-code-tools.qmd) — open-source agents that work with many models.
- [AI and your data](../da-knowledge/ai-and-your-data.qmd) — what providers keep, the GDPR and the EU AI Act for researchers.
- [Beyond the course](../da-knowledge/beyond.qmd) — curated videos, papers and further reading. Updated regularly.
